description:
Market-wide or sector screen on one dimension in a single call: named mining projects, enterprise value, cash and funding, M&A activity, capital raises, substantial-holder moves, insider trading, or company updates (guidance/buybacks/trading updates/distress/consolidations). Suited to questions about many ASX companies at once, a sector or a commodity group ('who has raised money in lithium lately', 'which gold producers upgraded guidance', 'cheapest companies vs cash'). Rows come back ordered, so the first page holds the most significant rows; when nextCursor is not null there are more rows (pass cursor=nextCursor, or fields='compact' for 500 rows a call). Free.

Insider trading is dimension='dealing'. direction='sales' (the default) returns insider sales ranked in dollars, so sizes compare across tickers; option exercises, vesting events, lapses and nil rows are removed and labelled as not insider selling or buying. direction='buys' returns on- and off-market purchases ranked in dollars, then placement/SPP participation labelled as not a market purchase; internal transfers between a director's own entities, equity grants, takeover mechanics and initial/final notices are not returned as buys. Option exercises are commonly reported in filings as insider buying; the dealing screen separates them from genuine purchases and sales.

Each row is drawn from the whole population in scope, so a dimension shows which companies are absent as well as which qualify.

calledHighGrade.description: intercepts: only intercepts the announcement calls high-grade (true) or not (false).

commodity.description: projects, raises and cash: substring match on a mining project's commodities, e.g. 'Lithium' (wider than the Lithium tag). intercepts: the assayed commodity, 'gold' or 'Au'.

currentOnly.description: people: only people who sit on at least one board today.

cursor.description: Next page: the nextCursor from the previous response. A non-null nextCursor means more rows follow; null is the last page.

dimension.description: What to sweep. 'cash' rows carry raisedSinceQuarterEndM, raisesSinceQuarterEnd and runwayAfterRaisesQuarters: a quarterly's runway predates any raise after the quarter end, so those fields extend it. 'raises' returns every placement, SPP, entitlement/rights issue, public offer and convertible in the window, one row per raise, ranked by dollar size (sort='discount' for deepest discount first): amount sought and completed, offer price, discount to the last close before the announcement, attaching options, lead manager, status (ANNOUNCED/CLOSED/EXTENDED/COMPLETED) and every docKey. Event rows (raises, dealing, updates, ma, holders) carry priceChangeDay0Pct and priceChange5dPct: the move from the close before the filing. Cleansing prospectuses, option-only offers and announcements re-released by another issuer are left out. A row with sameOfferAs set is a later leg (e.g. retail) of the offer that docKey announced, so the two amounts are one offer and are not additive. For a commodity ('lithium') pass commodity, not sector. 'holders' rows carry holderType (SUPER, FUND_MANAGER, CORPORATE, CUSTODIAN_OR_LENDER, INDIVIDUAL) and holderGroup (one key per institution across its name variants: 'australiansuper', 'state-street', 'first-sentier'); stock-lending notices are left out unless includeLending=true. 'drawdown' returns companies above minMarketCap that are minDrop (e.g. 0.5 = 50%) or more below their highest close in [highFrom, highTo] (default the last 52 weeks), with the high's date and the latest three price-sensitive filings since it: 'miners over $250m 50%+ off their May highs' = sector='Materials', minMarketCap=250000000, minDrop=0.5, highFrom='2026-05-01', highTo='2026-05-31' (since is not needed). 'intercepts' returns drill intercepts read from drilling results (hole, from, width, grade, unit, commodity, isIncluding, isHistorical, previouslyReported, calledHighGrade, gramMetres = g/t x m), ranked by gram-metres: filter commodity ('gold' or 'Au'), minGramMetres, historical (include|exclude|only), previouslyReported (default exclude: restated earlier results are left out), calledHighGrade; sort='gram_metres_asc' with calledHighGrade=true finds 'high-grade' claims on thin intercepts. 'holder_clusters' returns holders that moved in minCompanies+ companies within windowDays, one row per holder with every move and docKey: for a company building stakes use holderType='CORPORATE' and holderDirection='increase'; for a fund rotating, holderGroup or holderType='SUPER'. 'dealing' (or the legacy 'director_trading') returns insider trading: direction=sales (default) is ranked by DOLLAR size with option exercises, vesting, lapses, consideration issues and nil rows already removed; direction=buys returns insider buying. 'cash' answers 'who is raising next': one row per company (its latest quarterly), with effectiveRunwayQuarters (the stated runway, extended by any raise after the quarter end) and quartersOfCashLeftAsOf (the quarter end the estimate dates from - a June quarterly read in October is four months old). Filter maxMarketCap/minMarketCap, maxRunwayQuarters/minRunwayQuarters, excludeRaisedSinceQuarterEnd, commodity; sort='runway_asc' (default when maxRunwayQuarters is set), 'burn' (default) or 'cash'. 'Materials companies under $100m with under 2 quarters of cash that have not raised since' = sector='Materials', maxMarketCap=100000000, maxRunwayQuarters=2, excludeRaisedSinceQuarterEnd=true. A row with no market cap carries marketCapNote (usually: suspended) and is left out by market-cap filters. 'people' ranks directors by their record across every ASX board they have sat on (one row per person, resolved across name variants; since is not needed): sort='takeovers' (most companies taken over, then premium), 'excess'/'worst_excess' (median annualised share-price return vs CS200EW over completed board tenures of a year or more; minTenures, default 2, of those), 'dilution' (median dilution per year), 'busiest' (most current seats; role='ned' for busiest NEDs), 'raised', 'deep_discount' (raises at 20%+ discount), 'administrations'. Rows carry mergeStrength (strong = joined by a shared holding entity or a bio naming the other company; medium = name rarity alone) and the person's tenures with docKeys. Microcap returns are volatile: an excess median over 2 tenures is an anecdote, so minTenures=3+ gives a steadier median. The first page carries the caveats (survivorship: companies taken over or delisted before the corpus was built are absent). A person's full record is in person_profile.

direction.description: dealing dimension only: 'sales' (default) or 'buys'. Sales are ranked by DOLLAR size, not share count, so they are comparable across tickers.

excludeRaisedSinceQuarterEnd.description: cash: leave out companies that have raised since their quarter end (default false).

fields.description: 'compact': symbol, sector, date, value, class and docKey only - ~8x more rows per response; suited to market-wide sweeps (up to 500 rows per call).

guidanceQuality.description: updates+guidance only: 'complete' returns only rows with a stated figure on both sides and an unclosed period — the rows that can answer an old-vs-new question.

guidanceType.description: updates+guidance only: e.g. 'UPGRADE'. INITIATED and REAFFIRMED are not upgrades. UPGRADE/DOWNGRADE leave out cost and spending guidance (capex, exploration budgets, AISC), where a higher number is not better; every row carries metricClass (EARNINGS, REVENUE, PRODUCTION, COST, SPENDING, OTHER) and guidanceDriver (ORGANIC, ACQUISITION, DIVESTMENT, ACCOUNTING): an upgrade driven by an acquisition is not the business doing better. Guidance given before its period closed also carries actualOutcome (BEAT, IN_RANGE or MISS), actual, actualVsMid and resultsDocKey once the results are out, which answers 'did they hit their guidance'.

highFrom.description: drawdown: start of the window the high is taken from, YYYY-MM-DD (default 52 weeks ago).

highTo.description: drawdown: end of the high's window, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

holderDirection.description: holder_clusters: only increases or only decreases.

holderGroup.description: holders and holder_clusters: one institution across its name variants, e.g. 'australiansuper', 'state-street', 'forrestania-resources' (as returned in holderGroup).

holderType.description: holders and holder_clusters: one kind of holder.

includePassive.description: holder_clusters: include custodians/lenders and the index giants (Vanguard, BlackRock, State Street, Dimensional), left out by default.

limit.description: Max rows (default 25, max 100; responses are capped at 30,000 characters).

maxCashAgeDays.description: ev only: ignore cash reports older than this many days.

maxEv.description: ev: keep companies at or below this EV in DOLLARS.

maxMarketCap.description: cash: keep companies at or below this market cap in DOLLARS (e.g. 100000000).

maxRunwayQuarters.description: cash: keep companies with at most this many quarters of cash left (effectiveRunwayQuarters).

minAmountM.description: raises only: keep raises of at least this many A$ millions.

minCompanies.description: holder_clusters: at least this many companies (default 2).

minDrop.description: drawdown: minimum fall from the high as a fraction (0.5 = 50%; default 0.3).

minEv.description: ev only: keep companies at or above this EV in DOLLARS.

minGrade.description: intercepts: minimum grade in the intercept's unit.

minMarketCap.description: drawdown and cash: minimum market cap in DOLLARS (e.g. 250000000).

minRunwayQuarters.description: cash: keep companies with at least this many quarters of cash left ('well funded').

minTenures.description: people: minimum completed tenures behind a median (excess, worst_excess, dilution; default 2).

previouslyReported.description: intercepts: results the filing restates from an earlier release (quarterly summaries, cited prior holes). Default exclude, so each filing ranks on what it newly reports.

role.description: people: only board tenures in this role (ned = non-executive director).

sector.description: Sector, industry group, or tag — or 'all' for the whole market (default 'all').

since.description: Earliest event date YYYY-MM-DD (required for every dimension except drawdown and people; without it a sweep covers the whole corpus).

sort.description: people: takeovers | excess (default) | worst_excess | dilution | busiest | raised | deep_discount | administrations. raises: 'size' (default), 'discount' or 'date'. intercepts: 'gram_metres' (default), 'grade' or 'gram_metres_asc'. cash: 'runway_asc', 'burn' or 'cash'.

tag.description: Optional tag to narrow further, e.g. 'Copper'.

until.description: raises only: latest announcement date YYYY-MM-DD (default: today).

updateType.description: updates dimension only: narrow to one update type. distress = administrators, receivers, liquidators, covenant breaches, and rating cuts or negative outlooks that leave the company below investment grade; credit_rating = every other rating action, including investment-grade downgrades (BOQ A- to BBB+). Rows carry severity: SEVERE (insolvency, covenant breach), MODERATE (a rating cut or negative outlook) or MINOR.

windowDays.description: holder_clusters: days within which the moves fall (default 30).

name: market_screen
title: Market screen
